action_items: Backend lane not applicable: the acceptance matrix specifies React session state only and no API/database behavior; pytest exited 5 because no tests are defined. /api/health is not implemented (404), but no application flow calls it.

checks.criterion: Profil dan navigasi edukasi tetap berjalan
checks.name: profile-and-learning-flow
checks.evidence: Profile form accepted optional nickname and 2–3 tahun; empty-age validation displayed; /belajar rendered exactly 10 module cards.

checks.criterion: Hero tidak memakai gambar ber-background mengganggu
checks.name: hero-clean-plate
checks.evidence: Home hero rendered visibly with plate UI content, contained no img element, and CTA opened the profile form.

checks.criterion: Infografik materi yang relevan tetap tampil baik
checks.name: nutrition-infographic-mobile
checks.evidence: Nutrition infographic rendered at mobile width with alt text covering carbohydrate, animal/plant protein, vegetables, fruit, and water; no page horizontal overflow.

checks.criterion: Tiga tabel AKG lengkap tersedia di Referensi
checks.name: references-complete-tables
checks.evidence: References showed macro table with 8 rows, vitamin table with 14 rows, mineral table with 14 rows, both official age columns, and details interaction.

checks.criterion: Pemetaan usia website dan sumber PDF dijelaskan
checks.name: references-complete-tables
checks.evidence: References included 12–23 bulan, 2–3 tahun, 4–5 tahun mappings, PDF href ending .pdf, and non-individual disclaimer.

checks.criterion: Referensi nyaman pada laptop, desktop, dan HP
checks.name: references-complete-tables
checks.evidence: At 390px and 1280px viewports references remained visible and document horizontal overflow was false; nested table scrolling was exercised via responsive layout.

checks.name: core-education-interactions
checks.evidence: Plate validation/evaluation/reset, snack switch feedback, 8-question quiz completion, scenario feedback, and all 5 hygiene checks completed successfully.

checks.criterion: Tidak ada error runtime atau akses dasar yang regress
checks.name: main-routes-no-overflow
checks.evidence: Home and /belajar, /piringku, /camilan, /kuis, /skenario, /higiene, /ringkasan, and /referensi rendered main content at mobile width with no horizontal overflow; frontend GET / returned 200.
